name: Goldtooth
summary: Near Fargodeep Mine, Auntie Bernice Stonefield's necklace is missing, and the Stonefield and Maclure families blame each other. Billy Maclure admits he lost it while playing nearby, and you follow the trail to the kobold Goldtooth.

sections.title: A Boy's Mischief
sections.body: Auntie Bernice Stonefield's missing necklace has stirred up trouble between the Stonefield and Maclure families. Bernice suspects her rivals, but Billy Maclure lost the trinket while playing near Fargodeep Mine. He tries to hide his guilt, saying he only found the necklace before a creature snatched it away.

sections.title: The Den Above the Mine
sections.body: Billy says a large kobold with gleaming fangs took the shiny necklace and ran to a den above Fargodeep Mine. Goldtooth actually lurks on the mine's lower level. Slaying the kobold brings Bernice's necklace back, settles the families' dispute, and earns you an old campaign keepsake left by Bernice's late husband.

faq.answer: Billy Maclure most likely took Auntie Bernice's necklace. He lets slip that he lost it while playing near Fargodeep Mine, then says he only found it there. Before he could retrieve it, Goldtooth the kobold grabbed the shiny trinket.
Goldtooth lurks on the lower level inside Fargodeep Mine, though Billy says the kobold's den is above the mine.

faq.q: What kind of creature is Goldtooth?
faq.answer: Goldtooth is an oversized kobold with a gleaming golden fang. Like other kobolds, he is drawn to bright, shiny trinkets.

faq.q: How does this quest tie into the Maclure and Stonefield feud?
faq.answer: The Stonefields and Maclures are bitter rivals who blame each other for petty thefts and misfortunes. Auntie Bernice suspects the Maclures took her necklace out of spite, but the search reveals Billy lost it through carelessness.

faq.q: What is the reward from Auntie Bernice?
faq.answer: Auntie Bernice gives you an old keepsake that belonged to her late husband. She says it was lucky, but he forgot to take it on his final military campaign.

faq.q: What quest leads directly into Goldtooth?
faq.answer: Back to Billy leads directly into Goldtooth. You bribe Billy Maclure with pork, and he finally confesses what happened to the necklace.

angles.text: As a human, you help ease friction between two of Elwynn's oldest farming families and face the kobolds that plague the realm.
